rationale: The prompt's central requirement is Meeting notes and action extraction. The anchored # Software Architecture Fitness Review scopes the source-visible material to Analyzes code for software architecture fitness, producing scores (1-10) across coupling, cohesion, layering, modularity, naming, API design, and maintainability. Use when the user says /review:review-architecture, reque, which does not provide a plausible route to that central input/output boundary.
